title: AARO found SOM 1-01 crash-packaging manual

tellings.quote: They found like this this manual which talks about like packaging and unpackaging debris and craft and bodies from an extraterrestrial vehicle crash

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office set up to study unexplained objects, is said to have found a manual, called SOM 1-01 (heard on the show as "Psalm 101"), explaining how to package and unpack debris, craft and bodies from an extraterrestrial vehicle crash. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb relays this from what he was told, citing the office's officials Tim Phillips and Sean Kirkpatrick, which would mean the government once had procedures for handling alien crashes.
